business_summary: Comfort socks and tees with a social-good mission where every purchase results in a donation of an item to someone experiencing homelessness. Average order value is $65, and the products are positioned well for gifting and family multi-packs.
stated_claims: every purchase donates an item to someone experiencing homelessness

relevant_tags.why: Advertiser explicitly sells comfort socks as a core product.
Socks and tees are everyday essential basics.
Sells tees and socks, which are apparel items.
Comfort-focused socks and tees are inherently casual wear.
Explicitly highlights that the products are great for gifting.

note_signals.why: Direct competitor in the socks and basics categories, which will likely trigger a publisher block.
Values-driven organic grocery audience is highly receptive to social-good and donation-based messaging.

gate_reason: The product, AOV, core value proposition, and target use cases (gifting and family packs) are clearly defined and ready for matching.
missing_info: individual unit pricing for socks and tees
whether a subscription model is offered for recurring purchases
specific fabric or sustainability details beyond 'comfort'
clarifying_questions: What is the average retail price of a single pair of socks or a single tee?
Do you offer subscription options for your multi-packs, or are they strictly one-time purchases?
Are your products unisex, or do you offer separate lines for men, women, and kids?
